description: This file contains unit tests for the DataReaderV2 class, which reads media segment data from shared memory buffers. It uses Google Test framework to verify correct reading and parsing of media segments, including handling of optional parameters and encryption modes.

classes.name: Check
classes.description: Helper class to verify properties of media segments read by DataReaderV2, including presence of mandatory data, optional data, and encryption details.

classes.name: Build
classes.description: Builder class to create various types of media segments (video, audio) with optional and encryption parameters for testing.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Reads media segment data from shared memory for a given media source type.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes a media segment into shared memory buffer using IMediaFrameWriter.

methods.name: doSomeMessInMemory
methods.description: Corrupts shared memory to simulate parsing failure.
